question: What repeated obeisance is offered to the trident-handed Kedāra?
premises: Obeisance is directed to the trident-handed one.
The formula of obeisance is repeated.
inference: The verse offers repeated reverence to trident-handed Kedāra.
plain_english: Obeisance be to the trident-handed Kedāra; obeisance, obeisance.
